bounded_objective: Expand the exact shared-coordinate four-channel identity through two consecutive physical queries, decide whether internal source/crossed channels cancel, and derive the correct blockwise law.

input_handoffs_used.description: exact shared-coordinate four-channel law and signed-remainder Bellman falsifier
Brain mirror of the exact predecessor package

prior_mathematical_status: The exact one-query shared-coordinate identity was proved, but its source/crossed/remainder channels had not been propagated through two queries or an arbitrary block.
new_mathematical_status: PARTIAL_PROVED_AND_TERM_BY_TERM_CANCELLATION_REFUTED: an exact arbitrary-block channel identity and exact sequential/block reassociation theorem are proved; internal channel cancellation is replaced by an order-dependent signed transfer.
mathematical_delta: The multi-query algebra is now exact. A block B has one source and 2^|B|-1 selector-frequency channels. Sequential and simultaneous groupings differ by T_pi, which moves with opposite sign between source/crossed and child/remainder ledgers. A genuine activation-irreducible two-bit witness has T_(0,1)=-2ln2+(9/8)ln3 and T_(1,0)=0.
previous_value: one-query exact four-channel identity; no block closure
new_value: arbitrary-block exact identity plus L_pi=L_B+T_pi and M_pi=M_B-T_pi; termwise S/X cancellation false

case_extension.starting_class: one shared physical query with arbitrary coherent convolution
case_extension.new_class: every finite shared-coordinate block and every sequential query order
case_extension.exact_quantifiers: every finite dimension, Boolean g_+,g_-,h, finite physical block B, and coordinate ordering pi
case_extension.new_constant: exact identities with no parameter loss; no aggregate FEI constant obtained
case_extension.parameter_dependence: identities independent of dimension, bias and overlap; raw channel count is 2^|B|-1
case_extension.universal_gap: compress or pay the aggregate channel/remainder ledger without exponential block-size loss

scope: all 4096 Boolean triples on two bits and both query orders
exact displayed witness values and integer sign certificate
finite_check.arithmetic: exact Fraction Walsh arithmetic and exact rational log-prime vectors; Decimal only for displayed values

failed_or_insufficient_approaches: Internal source/crossed channels do not cancel termwise under coherent sequential conditioning.
Their allocation is order-dependent even though the complete entropy decrement is order-independent.
Separately enveloping 2^|B|-1 selector-frequency channels has no demonstrated dimension-free bound.
The reassociation witness is an obstruction to a bookkeeping mechanism, not an FEI counterexample.

review.previous_claim_review: No independent review of the immediately preceding four-channel claims was observed.

routing.note: Use the exact block identity and reassociation transfer. Do not assert termwise S/X cancellation or envelope all selector-frequency channels separately.
